meta.title: Recreate Order: Create Order after clearing all fields shows validation errors
gaps: The complete dynamic set of every required field in the Recreate Order dialog cannot be asserted because the catalog requires each field label to be named explicitly; the plan checks the known Product, Quantity Requested, Delivery location, and Price fields.

plan.title: Recreate Order validation after clearing fields

steps.note: Open the API-prepared live RFQ summary; this is the required starting state for prepared cases.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the Settings menu is available.
Open the Recreate Order window from the RFQ Settings menu.
Verify that the Recreate Order window opened.
Submit the now-empty form to trigger required-field validation.
Assert the required Product field reports an error.
Assert the required Quantity Requested field reports an error.
Assert the required Delivery location field reports an error.
Assert the required Price field reports an error.
Verify the validation errors leave the Recreate Order window open.
